chapter.heading: A song for pilgrims ascending to Jerusalem.
chapter.v:
I took
my troubles to the Lord;I cried out to him, and he answered my prayer.

Rescue me,
O Lord, from liarsand from all deceitful people.

O deceptive
tongue, what will God do to you?How will he increase your punishment?

You will
be pierced with sharp arrowsand burned with glowing coals.

How I
suffer in far-off Meshech.It pains me to live in distant Kedar.

I am
tired of livingamong people who hate peace.

I search
for peace;but when I speak of peace, they want war!
